purpose: Teach: コンビネーション/クズ/適格/供与/にあたり/勲章/公聴/意匠

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究領域のコンビネーションを工夫しろ
lines.en: Ren — refine your approach to combining research methodologies.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Lean forward slightly on the name to establish focus. Steady gaze. Confidence without harshness. No pause between name and instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験のクズ材、つまりクズデータも保管します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also archive the experimental waste materials — the rejected data sets.
lines.style: Quick agreement on the affirmative. Slight rush on the list of tasks, showing eager comprehension. Respectful straightness in posture. Ending on concrete detail to show thoroughness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究適格者リストを整えろ
lines.en: Ren — organize the collaborative research eligibility list.
lines.style: Same authoritative register as before. Pause is minimal. Weight falls on the action verb. Direct eye contact maintained. The tone of someone delegating to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会への試料供与を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with providing our samples to the conference.
lines.style: Rapid, compliant opening. Mid-sentence clarity — he's not just nodding, he's already planning the work. Slight lift at the end, showing he's ahead of the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文投稿にあたり、引用を整えろ
lines.en: Ren — before submitting the paper, make sure your citations are complete.
lines.style: Precision here. Slight emphasis on 「before」 — this is sequencing, not option. Voice stays level. The kind of instruction that prevents mistakes rather than punishes them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。受賞、つまり勲章獲得を励みに研究します
lines.en: Yes. I'll use the prospect of recognition — receiving awards — as motivation for the research.
lines.style: Affirmative is quick. Then a slight breath — he's moving from compliance to something more personal, more intrinsic. Softer tone on the reflection. Honest rather than performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の公聴会に出席しろ
lines.en: Ren — attend the conference public hearing session.
lines.style: Final instruction, same cadence as the others. Settling into the name. Expectation is clear but not heavy. The voice of a mentor whose instructions you follow not from fear but from respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の意匠、つまり意匠的アイディアも特許申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also file patents for the conceptual innovations — the design-based ideas — that emerge from the research.
lines.style: Fast agreement. Then a longer tail — he's thinking aloud now, connecting pieces. Builds momentum through the list. Ends with quiet determination. Showing both compliance and independent thinking.
